name: Price
definition: Amount of money for which goods, services or assets are offered, sold, or bought.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Price expressed as a currency and value.

UnitOfMeasure.name: Unit Of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.definition: Specifies the unit of measurement. For example: kilo, tons.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency code in which the price is expressed.

Factor.name: Factor
Factor.definition: Multiplication factor of measurement values. For example: 36 pieces.

Option.name: Option
Option.definition: Option for which a strike price is specified.

UnitPriceProduct.name: Unit Price Product
UnitPriceProduct.definition: Product for which a unit price is specified.

NetPriceProduct.name: Net Price Product
NetPriceProduct.definition: Product for which a net price is specified.

PriceAdjustment.name: Price Adjustment
PriceAdjustment.definition: Variance on price for the goods and services.

GrossPriceProduct.name: Gross Price Product
GrossPriceProduct.definition: Product for which a gross price is specified.

PriceTolerance.name: Price Tolerance
PriceTolerance.definition: Variance allowed on the price of goods.

Netting.name: Netting
Netting.definition: Netting for which an average price is specified.
